_fixture.source: isolated-server answer: GET on an isolated `pitwall serve` (127.0.0.1:8904, scratch data dir, LLM and voice off, UDP on 127.0.0.1:20904 with no game) from the feat/controls worktree while the backend was in progress, after the dashboard saved the recommended F1 25 PS5 layout for the GT DD Pro template. Not a live rig.

intro: In F1 25, open Controls > [your wheel's preset].
EA's controls hub lists driving controls, MFD shortcuts and UDP custom actions per device; the exact screen names on the console are not re-checked [U].
F1 25's preset for this wheel may already use this control (EA publishes default wheel buttons only for the Logitech G923).
F1 25 may drop or swap an action that was already on a button when you rebind it (unverified): check the list after each change.

steps.native: Activate/Deactivate DRS/S Mode (2026 cars: Active Aero Corner <-> Straight Line Mode)
steps.label: DRS / active aero (Activate/Deactivate DRS/S Mode)
steps.note: 2025 cars: DRS, in DRS zones 2026 cars: Active Aero Straight Line Mode, only in zones; the game returns to Corner Mode when you turn, brake or lift

steps.label: Overtake / boost
steps.note: 2026 cars: Overtake Mode once unlocked at the Detection Line

steps.native: MFD + MFD Menu Up/Down/Left/Right; panel shortcuts (Car Setup, Pit Setup, Damage, Engine State, Temperature)
steps.label: MFD / black box down (MFD Menu Down)

steps.native: MFD + MFD Menu Up/Down/Left/Right; panel shortcuts (Car Setup, Pit Setup, Damage, Engine State, Temperature)
steps.label: MFD / black box left (MFD Menu Left)

steps.native: MFD + MFD Menu Up/Down/Left/Right; panel shortcuts (Car Setup, Pit Setup, Damage, Engine State, Temperature)
steps.label: MFD / black box right (MFD Menu Right)

steps.native: MFD + MFD Menu Up/Down/Left/Right; panel shortcuts (Car Setup, Pit Setup, Damage, Engine State, Temperature)
steps.label: MFD / black box (open) (MFD)
steps.note: What this control sends isn't known: check it in the game.

steps.native: MFD + MFD Menu Up/Down/Left/Right; panel shortcuts (Car Setup, Pit Setup, Damage, Engine State, Temperature)
steps.label: MFD / black box up (MFD Menu Up)

outro: Open Test to check each button reaches Pitwall.
